add_where_before_categories.text: before the categories (after the article's text)

add_where_bottom.text: at the very bottom of the page

add_where_top.text: at the very top of the page

backfill_done.text: From the preview: {added} post(s) added, {updated} refreshed, out of {seen}.

backfill_failed.text: The preview could not be read: {error}

backfill_no_channel.text: The source channel has no public @name, so it has no preview to read.

backup_failed.text: The backup could not be made: {error}

backup_no_key.text: BACKUP_KEY is not set, so there is nothing to encrypt the copy with — and an unencrypted database is not sent instead.

backup_private_only.text: Ask for a backup in a direct message: the file is the whole database and must not land in a group, not even an administrators' one.

cmd_backfill.text: /backfill — read the channel's web preview; with «all», refresh what the bot heard itself as well

cmd_backup_dc.text: /backup — an encrypted copy of the database; the answer is yours alone

cmd_backup_tg.text: /backup — an encrypted copy of the database; private chats only

cmd_go_dc.text: /go task_id: <id> — start a prepared task; with dry: true — preview it first, writing nothing

cmd_go_tg.text: /go <id> — start a prepared task; /go <id> dry — preview it first, writing nothing

cmd_jobs.text: /jobs — what is running and how the last tasks ended

cmd_remwikiadmin_tg.text: /remwikiadmin <@name or ID> — take the appointment away

cmd_run_dc.text: /run what: [numbers or codes] — set up a run; the bot asks which wiki, where the pages come from and what to do

cmd_run_tg.text: /run [numbers or codes] — set up a run; the bot asks which wiki, where the pages come from and what to do

cmd_schedule_dc.text: /schedule — the repeating runs; action: on|off|del with schedule_id: <id> changes one

cmd_schedule_tg.text: /schedule — the repeating runs; /schedule on|off|del <id> changes one

cmd_status.text: /status — what the slots hold and when the last pass ran

cmd_tasks.text: /tasks — the numbered list of tasks the bot can be set to

cmd_update.text: /update — rebuild the news now; with «force», the pictures too

cmd_wikiadmin_dc.text: /wikiadmin — who is a wiki administrator; user: <who> wiki_user: <Fandom account> appoints one

cmd_wikiadmin_tg.text: /wikiadmin — who is a wiki administrator; /wikiadmin <@name or ID> <Fandom account> appoints one

dialog_bad_choice.text: There is no such number in the list. Answer with one of them.

dialog_bad_flags.text: Numbers separated by spaces, or «0» for none of them.

dialog_bad_time.text: The time is written «HH:MM», for example «20:00».

dialog_bad_value.text: That answer was not understood. Try again.

dialog_flags.text: Anything extra — mark what you want, numbers separated by spaces:

dialog_limit.text: At most how many pages? «0» or «-» means all of them.

dialog_namespaces.text: In which namespaces? Numbers separated by commas; «0» or «-» means articles only.

dialog_opened.text: The dialog is open in this channel — answer with ordinary messages.

dialog_pick_mechanics.text: Which ones? Numbers or codes, separated by spaces.

dialog_source.text: Where do the pages come from?

dialog_source_argument_backlinks.text: Which page should they link to?

dialog_source_argument_links.text: Which page's links should be taken?

dialog_source_argument_pairs.text: Send the renames, one per line: old_title new_title. A space in a title is written as an underscore; on Discord wrap the whole block in ``` so it is not turned into italics.

dialog_source_argument_prefix.text: What does the title start with?

dialog_source_argument_search.text: What to search the wiki for?

dialog_source_argument_titles.text: Send the titles — one per line, or separated by «|».

dialog_summary.text: The edit summary? A single dash «-» and the bot writes what it actually did.

dialog_when_minutes.text: At which minutes past the hour? For example «0,30».

dialog_when_weekdays.text: On which weekdays? Numbers separated by commas, 0 is Monday. For example «0,3».

dialog_wiki.text: Which wiki? The whole domain, for example telepedia.fandom.com/ru — a link to an article works too.

dialog_wiki_failed.text: That wiki could not be opened: {error}

flag_add_again.text: add it even when that text is already on the page

flag_add_newline.text: separate it with a blank line

flag_extra_components.text: the debatable foreign components (веб-, топ- and the rest)

flag_fix_labels.text: correct the labels of links too, [[Target|label]]

flag_iw_sort_only.text: add nothing: only move the block to the end of the page and sort it

flag_list_timestamp.text: the date of the last edit

flag_no_redirect.text: leave no redirect behind (needs an administrator's right)

flag_no_typos.text: no typo list, only the spelling rules

flag_protect.text: leave links, templates, tables and file names alone

flag_quotes.text: straight quotes into «guillemets» (risky with an odd number of them)

flag_regex.text: a regular expression (\1, \2 work in the replacement)

flag_rollback.text: by rollback (faster, needs the rollback right)

flag_template_list.text: the list of pages, not just the number

flag_template_redirects.text: count the redirects to the template too

flag_unlink_bold.text: make the words bold in place of the link

go_usage.text: How it works: /go <task number> runs it, /go <number> dry previews it without editing.

help_footer.text: The commands are for the bot's administrators; the wiki work is also for wiki administrators who hold rights on that wiki.

help_intro.text: Confederate Fandom — a bot for Fandom wikis: news on the main pages, a nightly standardisation of names, and the tasks run on request.

mech_addtext_desc.text: add a block of text at the top, at the bottom or before the categories

mech_category_desc.text: add, remove or move a category across pages

mech_category_graph_desc.text: the tree of subcategories under one: as text or as a .dot file

mech_cosmetic_desc.text: markup only, words untouched: spaces in headings, indents, spare blank lines, a dash for a hyphen

mech_delinker_desc.text: take files already deleted from the wiki off the pages; page links are left alone

mech_image_desc.text: replace one file with another, or take it off the pages

mech_interwiki_desc.text: add the missing links to other language versions, gather them at the end and sort them

mech_listpages_desc.text: write the page list to a file; changes nothing

mech_movepages_desc.text: rename pages: from a list of «old new», or by a rule — prefix, suffix, regular expression

mech_pravopys_uk_desc.text: §35, §36 and §126 of the 2019 Ukrainian spelling rules, and typos from a list of 172 rules

mech_protect_desc.text: protect pages from editing, renaming and uploading a new version of a file, or unprotect them

mech_punct_ru_desc.text: punctuation only, words untouched: spaces around marks; ellipses and commas on request

mech_redirect_desc.text: fix double redirects, point links straight at the target, find redirects leading nowhere

mech_replace_desc.text: find and replace text: by exact match or by regular expression

mech_revertbot_desc.text: undo one account's last consecutive edits

mech_templatecount_desc.text: how many pages use a template, several at once; the list itself on request

mech_typos_ru_desc.text: fix typos from a list of 607 rules; spaces around marks come with it, commas and cosmetics on request

mech_unlink_desc.text: remove the links to a page and leave the words behind

move_mode_list.text: from a list of «old new» pairs

not_admin.text: This command is for the bot's administrators only.

page_not_yours.text: These pages belong to whoever ran the command — run it yourself to page through it.

pageset_backlinks.text: the pages that link to one page

pageset_fileuse.text: the pages that use a file

pageset_links.text: the pages one page links to

pageset_pairs.text: a list of renames I will send

pageset_prefix.text: the pages whose title starts with

pageset_template.text: the pages that use a template

pageset_titles.text: a list of titles I will send

param_add_text.text: What text to add? Several lines are fine.

param_category_action.text: What to do with the category?

param_cosmetic_flags.text: What to keep the cosmetics away from?

param_delinker_days.text: How many days of the deletion log to read?

param_find.text: What to look for? (Plain text, or a regular expression — switched on by a flag below.)

param_graph_root.text: Start from which category? Without the prefix.

param_image_from.text: Which file to swap or remove? Without the «File:» prefix.

param_image_to.text: Swap it for which file? A single dash «-» removes it altogether.

param_interwiki_flags.text: How to handle the interlanguage links?

param_list_flags.text: What to write about each page?

param_move_argument.text: What exactly to add to, remove from or find in the title?

param_move_flags.text: What else should the move do?

param_move_to.text: Replace what was found in the title with what? \1, \2 work.

param_pravopys_uk_flags.text: What else to do along with the spelling?

param_protect_expiry.text: For how long? «infinite» means for good.

param_punct_ru_flags.text: How far should the punctuation go?

param_redirect_mode.text: What to do with the redirects?

param_replace.text: Replace it with what? A single dash «-» deletes what was found.

param_revert_user.text: Whose edits should be undone? The account name on the wiki.

param_templates.text: Which templates to count? Comma-separated, without «Template:».

param_typos_ru_flags.text: What else to do beside the typos?

param_unlink_flags.text: What to do with the link's words?

param_unlink_title.text: Which page should the links be taken off?

protect_level_all.text: everybody — that is, lift the protection

protect_what_upload.text: uploading a new version of a file (the point of it, for files)

queue_place.text: Task {id} is in the queue: place {position}.

queue_place_eta.text: Task {id} is in the queue: place {position}. It should start in about {eta}.

redirect_mode_broken.text: find the broken ones and write them into the report (edit nothing)

redirect_mode_double.text: fix the double ones (a redirect to a redirect)

redirect_mode_links.text: point links that go through a redirect straight at the target

run_unknown.text: No such mechanic: {what}. The full list is /tasks.

schedule_usage_discord.text: How it works: /schedule lists them; /schedule action: on|off|del schedule_id: <number> changes one.

schedule_usage_telegram.text: How it works: /schedule lists them, /schedule on|off|del <number>.

service_channel_failed.text: The source channel {channel} could not be read: {error}

service_species_done.text: Pokemon names: {checked} page(s) walked, {edited} corrected, {replaced} replacement(s), {failed} failure(s). Forms left for a human: {unknown}

service_species_failed.text: The walk over the Pokemon names failed: {error}

service_species_no_flag.text: The nightly walk over the Pokemon names was skipped: the account has no bot flag on {wiki}, and hundreds of unflagged edits would flood Recent changes. It needs the local bot group and the High-volume editing grant on the BotPassword.

stop_done.text: Task {id} stopped. What is already written on the wiki stays written.

task_created.text: Task {id} created: {wiki}, mechanics — {mechanics}. Counting the pages…

task_destructive.text: ⚠ Some of this cannot be undone by editing: deletion, moving, protection, rollback.

task_go_discord.text:
Run it: /go task_id: {id}
See first what it would do, writing nothing: /go task_id: {id} dry: true

task_go_telegram.text:
Run it: /go {id}
See first what it would do, writing nothing: /go {id} dry

task_not_waiting.text: Task {id} is «{state}» — there is nothing to confirm.

tasks_destructive_mark.text: (⚠ can only be undone by the opposite action)

tasks_header.text: What the bot can be told to do. Answer with a number or a code — several, separated by spaces, are fine.

update_no_news.text: There is no post with text in the channel yet, so there is nothing to publish.

update_partial.text: Only {have} of {count} news could be built — there are not enough posts with text in the channel. The remaining slots were left as they were.

update_unchanged.text: Nothing to change: the wiki already says what the channel does.

when_daily.text: every day, at the given time

when_hourly.text: every hour, at the given minutes

when_weekly.text: on the given weekdays, at the given time

wikiadmin_added.text: {name} ({user_id}) is now a wiki administrator, Fandom account {wiki_user}. Their rights on each wiki are checked before every run.

wikiadmin_empty.text: No wiki administrators have been appointed yet.

wikiadmin_no_user.text: It is not clear who is meant. Reply to their message, or give an @name or a numeric ID.

wikiadmin_no_wiki_user.text: Their Fandom account name is needed too — that is what the bot checks on the wiki.

wikiadmin_not_found.text: {user_id} was not a wiki administrator anyway.

wikiadmin_removed.text: {user_id} is no longer a wiki administrator.
